item.title: Sperm Whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep
item.description:
📝 Sperm whales are the only whale known to rest vertically. In a paper published today (23rd July) in the Journal of Experimental Biology, researchers discovered that while resting, sperm whales release gas bubbles to help them regulate their buoyancy and remain below the sea surface. Additionally, the results indicate that sperm whales start resting dives with less diving gas volume than for deep foraging dives.
🔗 Read more: https://news.st-andrews.ac.uk/archive/sperm-whales-blow-bubbles-to-achieve-restful-vertical-sleep/
